title: cirsium wallichii var. fasciculata
intro: Cirsium wallichii var. fasciculata, commonly known as the Himalayan thistle, is a plant species belonging to the aster family. The Himalayan thistle is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to this plant include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and hepatoprotective effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Cirsium wallichii var. fasciculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
